# Rafael Oviedo — roviedo.dev

> Full Stack Developer and AI Agent Engineer based in Venezuela. Builds production websites, custom SaaS, ERPs, and AI agents. Dev3pack Global Hackathon 2026 winner (#1 Venezuela, #28 worldwide of 386). Contact: devraor00@gmail.com

## Who

Rafael Oviedo (roviedo.dev) is a software engineer who designs and ships custom software: commercial websites, landing pages, SaaS platforms, internal ERPs, AI agents, and Meta Ads campaigns. He works remotely in Spanish and English.

## Hire him for

- Custom websites and conversion-focused landing pages (Next.js, SEO, Vercel)
- SaaS and web apps (auth, dashboards, databases, production deploy)
- Custom ERPs and internal systems (inventory, invoicing, tickets, RBAC)
- AI agents and automation (Claude API, Codex, operational bots)
- Meta Ads / performance marketing (budgets up to $3,000/month)

- Dev3pack Global Hackathon 2026: #1 Venezuela, Top 9 LATAM, #28 of 386 projects (Tropico Wallet).

## Proof

- Tropico Wallet — Solana USDC ↔ Venezuelan Pago Móvil rail with AI agent. #1 Venezuela, Top 9 LATAM, #28 global at Dev3pack 2026.
- Llave — rental marketplace with Claude-powered AI agent. Platanus · Anthropic Hackathon 2026.
- COPS Platform — enterprise ticketing ERP, university thesis now used in production.
- iParts Platform — operations ERP for an iPhone repair shop: lot → workshop → QA → sale → warranty. Live at https://app.ipartsve.com. Next.js + NestJS + Prisma + PostgreSQL.
- Churupitos — live personal-finance PWA for Venezuela (USD / Bs / USDT) at app.churupitos.com.
- Invictus ERP and iPhone-store ERPs — inventory, sales, invoicing in production.
- Meta Ads operator for tech, repair, and retail clients.
